dedupe_keys.name: seznam kategoriziranih obcinskih cest v obcini hrastnik

description: Seznam kategoriziranih občinskih cest v Občini Hrastnik is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA HRASTNIK. The collection contains a list of categorized municipal roads in the Municipality of Hrastnik No of road or section - Marking of road section Name of the road - Local name of the road Length of road - Length of road in meters. Coverage: OBČINA HRASTNIK. The portal shows the English title as "List of categorized municipal roads in the Municipality of Hrastnik" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA HRASTNIK. Its keywords include javne ceste, občinske ceste, seznam. The listing shows 4 download or service links in XLSX, CSV, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
